transduction.thesis: every special-sense transducer is an R19 bistable/cooperative channel switch [V structure / L threshold]

transducers.cited_behaviour: single-photon response is discrete and reproducible; light->PDE->cGMP drop->channels shut (<1 ms)

transducers.channel: hair-cell MET channel (mechano-electrical transduction; gating-spring gated)
transducers.cited_behaviour: two states (open/closed), negligible transit; channel opening lowers bundle stiffness -> NEGATIVE stiffness -> active amplification
transducers.cited_threshold: bundle deflection ~0.1-1 nm at hearing threshold; ~10-20% channels open at rest (poised)
transducers.ref: Howard & Hudspeth 1988; Corey & Hudspeth 1983; Markin & Hudspeth 1995; Martin/Mehta/Hudspeth 2000

transducers.channel: taste GPCR (T1R2/T1R3 sweet, T1R1/T1R3 umami; T2R bitter) -> PLCb2 -> TRPM5 cation channel
channel_genes: NCBI Gene 29850; UniProt Q9NZQ8 (downstream cation channel)
transducers.cited_behaviour: receptor activation past a concentration threshold opens the downstream cation channel (switch)
transducers.cited_threshold: sweet/umami EC50 in mM (ligand-specific); bitter (TAS2R) nM-mM; concentration-response sigmoidal
transducers.ref: Chandrashekar et al. 2006 Nature 444:288; Zhang et al. 2003

transducers.channel: olfactory CNG channel (same CNG superfamily as rod) downstream of OR GPCR -> cAMP
transducers.cited_behaviour: same CNG channel family as phototransduction -- one shared switch primitive across two senses
transducers.cited_threshold: odorant->OR->cAMP->CNG; combinatorial coding across ~400 human ORs
transducers.note: master gamma not in atlas -> DNA pipeline fetch (measured input, not fitted)
